boundary.dated: Use the cited edition; withdrawal does not cancel an explicit incorporation.

boundary.delegation: Retain the xAPI observable requirement and assign its implementation to a runtime/library/primitive. Do not require an independent implementation or certification of all IEEE 754/ISO 8601 provisions.
boundary.completion: Projection means requirements and delegation obligations are represented, not that dependencies or the product have passed integration verification.
